params.caption: 🎮 Take-Two boss warns against AI-made GTA 6 PC ports Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has responded to the idea that unofficial, AI-assisted PC versions of Grand Theft Auto 6 could appear soon after launch, sending a warning to anyone planning such pirate ports. GTA 6 is launching on consoles first, with no official PC version announced yet. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 12:58 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto #GTA6 #TakeTwo #GamingNews
